prompt: Composition: Chronological entries with dates on a shared rail, compact media, explicit sequence. Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Set headings in League Gothic and reading text in Libre Baskerville; condensed display heading with reading serif. Use Forest and Lemon: page #F8FCF9, text #16362B, accent #357346, secondary surface #F2E64B, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 18px, heading 64px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 24px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
